# Shillington Education

> > Online graphic design and motion design courses for career changers, featuring portfolio-building projects, an active graduate community, and real student work showcases.

Shillington Education is a leading online design school offering comprehensive graphic design and motion design courses designed for career changers and creative professionals. With 30 years of industry experience, the school emphasizes hands-on portfolio building, mentorship, and community support to help students transition into design careers.

## Key Topics

- Graphic Design Course
- Motion Design
- Portfolio Building
- Brand Identity
- Packaging Design
- Career Change
- Design Education
- Student Work
- Branding
- Full-time/Part-time Options
- Beginner-friendly
- Graduate Community
- Company Rebrand
- Design Skills

## Student Work & Portfolio

- [Nem Nicholl Student Work](https://www.shillingtoneducation.com/student-work/nem-nicholl-student-work): Student portfolio: Balise sustainable branding with cyanotype design
- [Maddy Patcheak Student Work](https://www.shillingtoneducation.com/student-work/maddy-patcheak-student-work): Student portfolio: Snappys and Vlasic Pickles packaging rebrand project
- [Kitty Jörg-Smith Student Work](https://www.shillingtoneducation.com/student-work/kitty-jorg-smith-student-work): Student portfolio: Bronnen Estate branding and graphic design project
- [Talia Bernstien Student Work](https://www.shillingtoneducation.com/student-work/talia-bernstien-student-work): Student portfolio: Protocol+ wellness tea brand identity and packaging
- [Carson Fidje Student Work](https://www.shillingtoneducation.com/student-work/carson-fidje-student-work): Student portfolio: Dapper non-alcoholic beer packaging design project
- [Martina Ades Student Work](https://www.shillingtoneducation.com/student-work/martina-ades-student-work): Student portfolio: Off-screen visual design with hand-made masks project
- [Mim Chadwick Motion Student Work](https://www.shillingtoneducation.com/student-work/mim-chadwick-motion-student-work): Motion design portfolio: SheKicks women's football rebranding case study
